column1: # E1 barrier active-set acquisition experiment -- PROVENANCE STAMP
# piqp version               : v0.6.3 (pinned by the archived build_piqp.sh; see its banner)
# piqp install prefix        : /home/ghecht/Software/piqp  (EXTERNAL -- never vendored into any repository)
# piqp OpenMP                : BUILD_WITH_OPENMP defaults OFF and was never enabled;
#                              ldd on the driver links no libgomp, no BLAS, no MKL:
# copied, never edited in place. The workspace's driver (piqp_e1_driver.cpp)
# is DERIVED from that archive's piqp_f7_driver.cpp; the generator
# (e1_generate.cpp) and the dump container (e1_dump.h) are new.
# threads                    : MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 exported for every
#                              cell. Neither is read by PIQP; the ldd evidence above is
# scheduling                 : SEQUENTIAL, one process at a time; no cell co-ran with
#                              another. The box was not otherwise serialized, which is
#                              admissible only because NO WALL-CLOCK CLAIM IS MADE from
# per-cell budget            : 120 s hard timeout on the whole run invocation
#                              (timeout -k 5 120), dump parse included. A timeout is a
# retry policy               : one retry on cell GENERATION failure only. A solve that
#                              fails is recorded as it failed and never retried.
# solver tolerance           : eps_abs = 1e-10, eps_rel = 0, duality-gap check OFF,
#                              point; max_iter deliberately generous so the '< 40
#                              iterations' question is read off info.iter after the
#                              solve, not enforced as a budget).
# start                      : NEUTRAL COLD on every cell. PIQP has no primal/dual/slack
#                              seeding surface at all (solve() takes no arguments), so
#                              every row here runs its own from-scratch barrier
#                              initialization -- cold is not a choice, it is the only
